$comment: Fernhollow. The engine only rolls encounters on tall grass, so the fern under the fallen roof is what carries this table -- which is also why the cave has a fallen roof. Levels sit one over Route 2's own band because the player arrives here with the route already half walked, and the mix is what Route 2 does not have: SOOTMOTH is the flame/chitin the surface table only offers after dark, and MOSSBACK at eight percent is the prize -- verdant/stone, 90 catch rate, no evolution, and a genuinely useful wall for the Terra Hall at Stonewake, which is the next thing the player is going to walk into. Weights are stacked on the two commons so a player farming here for Mossback still gains levels while they do it.
